messages:
maria.s: :rotating_light: Security advisory — discovered exposed SMTP/webhook credentials for our marketing mailhook integration in a third-party analytics repo. We're rotating affected secrets now and enabling a Conditional Access policy on the service principal. Immediate actions below; please follow ASAP. Prod + staging impacted. Dev keys already revoked.

alex.k: On it — rotating mailbox creds and updating mailhook config. ETA ~30m. Which envs are impacted?

maria.s: Prod and staging. Staging first (canary). Enforcement of CA policy scheduled for 2024-05-03T18:00:00Z (24h). If you cannot rotate before that, file an exception with justification.

jen.w: Do we have a runbook/automation for rotation? can share a script?

maria.s: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/security/advisories/1719001234 — short script below for rotating a secret and updating k8s secret ref (example):

```bash
# AWS Secrets Manager example (update secret value and patch k8s)
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id mailhook/smtp --secret-string '{"user":"svc-mailhook","pass":"NEW_VALUE"}'
kubectl -n marketing set secret mailhook-smtp --from-literal=password=NEW_VALUE
# verify rollout
kubectl -n marketing rollout status deploy/mailhook --timeout=2m
```

Also Azure Key Vault and GCP snippets in the runbook. If you automate, ensure new secret uses short TTL and is referenced by secret id (not literal).

ops-bot: Deployment lock applied to service: mailhook (reason: rotating credentials). Auto-paused deploys until secrets verified.

alex.k: Rotated in staging and verified messages flowing :white_check_mark:. Pushed config change to staging with new secret ref. Preparing prod PR — will request prod deploy in 10m.

jen.w: Updated terraform var to use new secret id `rot-171900` and kicked CI. CI passed; awaiting prod approval.

maria.s: Thanks. Security will run an IAM/service-principal audit tonight and force-rotate any client secrets older than 90 days or using legacy auth flows. If you need an exception, tag me with reason + mitigation.

oncall-bot: Monitoring rule created: mailhook error rate >1% for 5m -> page oncall. Post-rotation, please watch delivery metrics for 2 hours and report anomalies here.

maria.s: Final note: rotate any long-lived tokens, avoid embedding credentials in third-party repos, and prefer certificate-based or federated auth for service principals. Reach out if you hit blockers. Thanks everyone. :pray:
